hook: Indian white-collar hiring grew just 2% last month. AI/ML hiring grew 20%.
commentary:
Indian white-collar hiring grew just 2% last month. AI/ML hiring grew 20%.

That's Naukri's JobSpeak index for September 2026, based on job postings on Naukri. The market isn't growing much. It's re-sorting.

Where demand moved, year on year:
→ AI/ML roles: +20%
→ Auto: +11%
→ GCCs and BPO/ITES: +4% each
→ IT/software services: −4%
→ Education: −18%

By experience:
→ Freshers: +1%
→ 4–7 years: −2%
→ 8–12 years: +5%

By city: Hyderabad +9%, Chennai +6%, Bengaluru +4%. Delhi NCR and Mumbai −6% each.

What this means for your CV:
• Moving from IT services to a GCC or an AI-adjacent role? Your CV has to speak the new role's language, not your old project's internal jargon.
• Growing roles attract more applicants. The skills recruiters search for need to be visible in the top third of page one.
• A generic CV sent to 50 openings loses to a tailored one sent to 10.
